summary: Reject ambiguous snapshot and host bootstrap inputs

delivery.outcome: Reject duplicate or unreadable snapshot inventory paths and contain host-package bootstrap reads/writes to canonical source and target paths before copying. Preserve valid migration/bootstrap behavior and join material patch0.20.127 through exact-head protected review, merge and immutable publication.
nonGoals: Change foreign393, cached validation, the Python secret scanner, local-origin URI grouping, consumer heads, dependencies or protected publication policy.
Install host files into any real target/user directory during regression tests or remove unknown work.
Provide filesystem isolation against a hostile process running with the same user privileges; callers retain exclusive target-checkout ownership.

architecture.decision: Keep public CLI/function signatures. Reject duplicate decoded Git inventory paths before dictionary assignment, and return the existing typed migration diagnostic for unsupported inventory bytes. Keep the bundled migration module byte-identical. Preflight every selected host-package mapping before the first destination write: closed literal relative paths, no traversal, controls, Git metadata or symlink/reparse components, regular sources and unambiguous targets. Read validated source bytes before copying; replace regular destination files atomically so existing hardlink referents are preserved. Recheck parents at the effect boundary and retain ordinary managed hook modes and read-only --check behavior. Keep implementation self-contained in the existing installer with standard-library Python only. Every adverse filesystem fixture is newly created, owned and disposable.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded material patch through protected delivery; preserve unknown and foreign data.

validation.evidence: Actual duplicate-name Git trees reject with the existing typed diagnostic in source and bundle; valid inventories and migration proofs still work.

Invalid source/target traversal, absolute/control paths, duplicates and symlink paths reject before file/config changes. Valid bootstrap/check/additional hooks still pass; atomic replacement retains an outside hardlink referent.
